title: OtpInput
description: A one-time password input with configurable length, grouping, paste support, and custom input rendering.

defaultValue.description: Initial OTP value for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: (value: string) => void - Fires when the OTP value changes.

onComplete.description: (value: string) => void - Fires when all fields are filled.

label.description: React.ReactNode - Label rendered above the input.

description.description: React.ReactNode - Helper text rendered below the label.

error.description: Displays the input in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Error message displayed below the input.

success.description: Displays the input in a success state.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode - Success message displayed below the input.

groups.description: Defines grouping of input fields (e.g. [3, 3] for two groups of 3).

autoFocusFirst.description: Automatically focuses the first input on mount.

inputType.description: HTML input type for each field.

inputPattern.description: HTML pattern attribute for input validation.

fullWidth.description: Makes the input span the full width of its container.

renderInput.description: (props: OtpInputRenderProps) => ReactNode - Custom render function for individual input fields.

validate.description: (char: string) => boolean - Custom validation function for each character.

inputAriaLabel.description: (index: number, length: number) => string - Function to generate aria-label for each input.

groupAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the input group.
